title: Blue extraterrestrial manifesting physically in the Scole experiment seances

tellings.quote: But he talked about being in seances where a blue extraterrestrial being would manifest. Manifest physically to the point where he could touch them.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies the mind and the paranormal, passes on what a man named Robin Foy told him about séances held in Scole, England, in the 1990s. According to Mishlove, Foy said a blue extraterrestrial being would appear in the room so physically that he could touch it. If true, it would link contact with other beings to spirit séances.
